title: Asymptotics for a nonstandard risk model with multivariate subexponential claims and constant interest force
summary: In this paper, the asymptotic behavior of the entrance probability of discounted aggregate claims of a certain family of rare sets is studied, considering the finite and infinite time horizons. This multivariate risk model, driven by a common counting process, has a constant interest rate and allows the interdependence of claim vectors. For the finite time horizon, the multivariate subexponential distribution of the common claim vector and the weak dependence structure of regression dependence are used.
